text: ほとんど　てつだうとこ　なかったわ　ニシキー！

structure.jp: ほとんど　てつだうとこ　なかったわ
structure.en: there was hardly anything for me to help with

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb right before a thing describes it. とこ is short for ところ, 'place, part'. てつだうとこ = 'a part to help with'.

patterns.name: ほとんど〜ない
patterns.span: ほとんど　てつだうとこ　なかった
patterns.explanation: ほとんど with a 'not' word means 'hardly any'. ほとんど てつだうとこ なかった = 'there was hardly anything to help with'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: In Kansai dialect, わ at the end is used by men too and lightly stresses what was said. なかったわ = 'there wasn't any, I tell you'.
